fields.Name: T65 - Entity Form Related Records Organization
fields.Description: Verifies that an Organization's full record form exposes a related Members section and that the members belonging to that organization are listed.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer, open the 'Organizations' entity, click an organization row (e.g. Alpine Creamery Co.), and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full organization form. Locate the related-records sections (tabs or panels on the form) and open the related 'Members' section. Reach the state where the members belonging to that organization are listed in that section's grid. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full organization form is open with the related Members section selected
The related Members section lists the members for that organization (or shows an explicit empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
